summary: [spec fidelity, P3] The last And of subject.lifecycle.31 says a reason on any other move is recorded with the actor and that the next move clears it. Only subject_lifecycle_31b_any_transition_accepts_a_reason_and_records_it (crates/canon-cli/tests/subject.rs:1582) checks that, and no evidence binds it: the evidence of .31 names only subject_lifecycle_31_a_reopen_needs_a_reason, which never moves with a reason. reword-2_2 says '31b covers the last And'. Fix: bind the 31b case to subject.lifecycle.31 (--report-case), or drop the And.
